newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady, mill demand slows.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady, mill demand slows.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Tuesday held steady in a narrow price range on the local market, dealers said.
Demand from consumers and retailers slowed but prices moved in a narrow band on limited arrivals and limited offerings.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,420/1,445 rupees per quintal and sugar M-30 at 1,460/1,495 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery too remained steady at 1,360/1,370 rupees per quintal.

"Fresh outstation buying at the mill level remained slow but offerings by the millers were also scattered as most of the millers have already sold out their quantity of free sale quota for the current month," one broker said.
The free sale quota for the current month is 800,000 tonnes against 750,000 tonnes released last month. The quota for June is 800,000 tonnes, dealers said.
